summary: SPX (7,599.96) and NDX (30,513.86) printed fresh ATHs on a narrow, barbell tape. Nvidia's Computex unveiling of the RTX Spark PC superchip drove tech (NVDA ~+6%, ARM +15.73%, DELL +10.75%) while disrupting incumbents (INTC -4%, AMD -5%, QCOM -8.78%). Energy was the only other green sector on Iran/Hormuz escalation (WTI ~$92, +~5.8%). Strong ISM (54.0) with hot prices sent yields up; gold and defensives sold. ATH printed on net-negative breadth (SPX Adv/Dec 207/293) with NDX RSI-15 at 77.78, the most overbought of the cycle.
